items.headline: Chiefs roll into Week 6 unbeaten as winless Chargers face a daunting trip to Kansas City
items.description: — The Kansas City Chiefs are the last remaining unbeaten team in the AFC, and one of just three in the entire NFL heading into Week 6, while the Los Angeles Chargers are among the suffering trio of teams that have yet to win a game.
